author: ArkansasIo

commands.name: Roll dice
commands.description: Roll any dice notation (e.g. 2d6+3, d20). Stores the total in the current map object properties.

defaultParameters.name: diceNotation
defaultParameters.description: Dice notation to roll, e.g. 1d20, 2d6+3

defaultParameters.name: advantage
defaultParameters.description: Roll with advantage (roll twice, keep highest). Only applies to d20 rolls.

defaultParameters.name: disadvantage
defaultParameters.description: Roll with disadvantage (roll twice, keep lowest). Only applies to d20 rolls.

commands.name: Roll initiative
commands.description: Roll initiative for a creature and add it to the combat order. Uses creature id -1 for the current map object.

defaultParameters.name: creatureId
defaultParameters.description: ID of the creature (DnD5E registry id). -1 uses the current map object's bound creature.

commands.name: Start combat
commands.description: Begin combat: sort the initiative order and highlight the current combatant.

commands.name: End combat
commands.description: End the current combat and clear the combat state.

commands.name: Next turn
commands.description: Advance to the next combatant in the initiative order.

commands.name: Deal damage
commands.description: Deal damage to a creature. Damage can be a flat amount or a dice expression.

defaultParameters.name: creatureId
defaultParameters.description: ID of the creature to damage. -1 uses the current map object.

defaultParameters.name: amount
defaultParameters.description: Amount of damage, or dice expression like 2d6+3

defaultParameters.name: damageType
defaultParameters.description: Type of damage: slashing, piercing, bludgeoning, fire, cold, etc.

commands.name: Heal
commands.description: Heal a creature by a flat amount or dice expression.

defaultParameters.name: creatureId
defaultParameters.description: ID of the creature to heal. -1 uses the current map object.

defaultParameters.name: amount
defaultParameters.description: Amount of healing, or dice expression like 2d8+2

commands.name: Make attack
commands.description: Roll an attack with a weapon or attack action. Handles advantage, crits and damage.

defaultParameters.name: attackerId
defaultParameters.description: ID of the attacking creature. -1 uses the current map object.

defaultParameters.name: targetId
defaultParameters.description: ID of the target creature. -1 uses the current map object.

defaultParameters.name: weaponName
defaultParameters.description: Name of the weapon to attack with (from SRD weapons).

defaultParameters.name: advantage
defaultParameters.description: Attack with advantage

defaultParameters.name: disadvantage
defaultParameters.description: Attack with disadvantage

commands.name: Cast spell
commands.description: Cast a known/prepared spell by name, using the creature's spell slots.

defaultParameters.name: casterId
defaultParameters.description: ID of the spellcaster. -1 uses the current map object.

defaultParameters.name: targetId
defaultParameters.description: ID of the target creature. -1 uses the current map object.

defaultParameters.name: spellName
defaultParameters.description: Name of the spell to cast (from SRD spells).

defaultParameters.name: level
defaultParameters.description: Level of the spell slot to use (0 for cantrips). Leave empty for the spell's base level.

commands.name: Apply condition
commands.description: Apply a condition to a creature: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Grappled, Incapacitated, Invisible, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Stunned, Unconscious, Exhaustion.

defaultParameters.name: creatureId
defaultParameters.description: ID of the creature. -1 uses the current map object.

defaultParameters.name: condition
defaultParameters.description: Name of the condition to apply.

commands.name: Remove condition
commands.description: Remove a condition from a creature.

defaultParameters.name: creatureId
defaultParameters.description: ID of the creature. -1 uses the current map object.

defaultParameters.name: condition
defaultParameters.description: Name of the condition to remove.

commands.name: Short rest
commands.description: Take a short rest: spend hit dice to heal, refresh features that recharge on short rest.

defaultParameters.name: creatureId
defaultParameters.description: ID of the creature resting. -1 uses the current map object.

defaultParameters.name: spendHitDice
defaultParameters.description: Number of hit dice to spend to heal during the rest.

commands.name: Long rest
commands.description: Take a long rest: restore all HP, hit dice and spell slots.

defaultParameters.name: creatureId
defaultParameters.description: ID of the creature resting. -1 uses the current map object.

commands.name: Ability check
commands.description: Roll an ability check for a creature.

defaultParameters.name: creatureId
defaultParameters.description: ID of the creature. -1 uses the current map object.

defaultParameters.name: ability
defaultParameters.description: Ability to check: Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma

commands.name: Skill check
commands.description: Roll a skill check for a creature.

defaultParameters.name: creatureId
defaultParameters.description: ID of the creature. -1 uses the current map object.

defaultParameters.name: skill
defaultParameters.description: Skill to check: Acrobatics, Athletics, Deception, History, Insight, Intimidation, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, Perception, Performance, Persuasion, Religion, Sleight_of_Hand, Stealth, Survival

commands.name: Saving throw
commands.description: Roll a saving throw for a creature.

defaultParameters.name: creatureId
defaultParameters.description: ID of the creature. -1 uses the current map object.

defaultParameters.name: ability
defaultParameters.description: Ability for the saving throw.

commands.name: Create creature
commands.description: Create a new D&D creature and bind it to the current map object.

defaultParameters.name: name
defaultParameters.description: Name of the creature.

defaultParameters.name: race
defaultParameters.description: SRD race name, e.g. Human, Elf, Dwarf.

defaultParameters.name: className
defaultParameters.description: SRD class name, e.g. Fighter, Wizard, or empty for a monster.

defaultParameters.name: level
defaultParameters.description: Character level (or monster CR).

commands.name: Create from SRD
commands.description: Create a creature from an SRD monster or NPC stat block and bind it to the current map object.

defaultParameters.name: name
defaultParameters.description: SRD monster or NPC name, e.g. Goblin, Owlbear, Commoner, Guard.

commands.name: Show character sheet
commands.description: Open the D&D character sheet UI for a creature.

defaultParameters.name: creatureId
defaultParameters.description: ID of the creature to display. -1 uses the current map object.

commands.name: Show combat tracker
commands.description: Open the D&D combat tracker UI showing the current initiative order.

commands.name: Add XP
commands.description: Add experience points to a creature and handle level up.

defaultParameters.name: creatureId
defaultParameters.description: ID of the creature gaining XP. -1 uses the current map object.

defaultParameters.name: amount
defaultParameters.description: Amount of XP to add.

defaultParameters.name: Enable UI
defaultParameters.description: Enable the in-game D&D character sheet and combat tracker UI.

defaultParameters.name: UI scale
defaultParameters.description: Scale factor for the D&D UI (0.5 to 2).

description:
Brings the Dungeons & Dragons 5th Edition SRD (System Reference Document 5.1) into RPG Paper Maker: races, classes, backgrounds, feats, weapons, armor, equipment, spells, monsters and NPCs, plus a full rules engine (ability checks, saving throws, skill checks, combat, initiative, conditions, rests, spell slots, leveling) and in-game character sheet + combat tracker UIs.

Content and mechanics are from the D&D 5e SRD and are licensed under the Open Game License 1.0a (OGL). This plugin does not include any non-SRD copyrighted text.
name: DnD5e

parameters.name: Enable UI
parameters.description: Enable the in-game D&D character sheet and combat tracker UI.

parameters.name: UI scale
parameters.description: Scale factor for the D&D UI (0.5 to 2).
